school.name: Esperanza Preparatory Academy
school.overview: Esperanza Preparatory Magnet School for Early College, Exploration, and Leadership is a 6-12 school that aims to prepare students to be successful in college. Through project-based learning, our mission is to ignite curiosity in all our learners and empower future leaders. Students get the opportunity to take college accredited courses and a variety of AP courses in order to develop their career and personal interests. We are committed to innovation, academic excellence, cross- cultural awareness, multilingualism, family, and community.
